author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: F&S Elektronik Systeme has introduced an M.2 AI accelerator based on the NXP Ara-240, designed to offload inference workloads from embedded systems. It targets edge applications requiring low-latency processing, including machine vision, multimodal inference, and real-time analytics. title: F&S M.2 AI Accelerator Uses NXP Ara-240 for Edge Inference Workloads
